generator: OpenAI built-in image_gen; whole-character endpoint-guided cel edits
scope: Five additional walking cels, three departure cels. Forty-nine walk poses and eight departure/settle poses in the forward cabin-to-first-field preview.
sources: candidates.json includes prompts, parent identities and source PNGs. Rejected initial versions remain separate; revisions.json records the second pass.
protection: Use PixelPatch and SkinPalette, restore original head or upper-body RGBA with Godot, then hash. No original v17-v22 images are overwritten. Runtime draws one intact image, with no ghost blend or limb stretch.
presentation: farm-fine-v1 uses foot-anchored 0.25-world-unit art pixels (132 pixels per 33-unit body), a shared 36-color warm earth/green palette and binary silhouette coverage. The farm background is unchanged. Desktop pet uses the same shader at 1.4 logical units per art pixel. Per-cel spatial sampling only, no temporal blending.
timing: Sixty-three one-or-two-tick intervals per 1.05-second cycle, based on boot and hand motion. Existing distance-driven route, acceleration and braking remain unchanged.
build: Place outputs in gardener-v23/frames; keep rejected builds separately
quality: Protected pixels, hashes, phase exposure, departure cancellation, route/root motion, native window interactions, normal-scale scene review and paired rendering. Pixel-difference metrics across palette styles are not directly comparable and do not certify aesthetic quality.
